name: google-ads
description: Declarative Google Ads connector for v22 customer, campaign, ad group, direct-read, and limited guarded reverse-ETL API surfaces.

risk.read: external Google Ads API reads of customer, campaign, ad-group, and bounded direct-read metadata
risk.write: limited guarded Google Ads API reverse/write actions with closed record schemas; destructive/admin actions require explicit approval
risk.approval: reads require no approval; writes remain gated by plan -> preview -> explicit approval -> execute
